#!/bin/sh
set -eu
for directory in "$HOME"/.local/share/ji-host/operations/install-0.1.0-SNAPSHOT-*; do
  test -d "$directory" || continue
  printf 'OPERATION %s\n' "$directory"
  ls -la "$directory"
  for file in previous-target ports complete activated backups-before; do
    if test -f "$directory/$file"; then
      printf '%s bytes=' "$file"
      wc -c < "$directory/$file"
    fi
  done
done
